home.hero: Own a piece of Miami. Use it, rent it, sell when the time is right.

problemFrame.title: Most foreign buyers find out what the building really allows after they've signed.
problemFrame.body1: Of new South Florida construction in 2025, 49% sold to international buyers — per MIAMI Realtors' 2025 Global Report. Many discover after closing that the declaration or HOA doesn't support how they planned to own.

founder.name: Isaac Andretta
founder.statLabelYears: years in South Florida real estate
founder.memo: I started Room 305 because most owners find out what their building really allows after they've bought it. We follow the corridor building by building — the rules, the rental program details, the operating realities — so when we help someone buy, sell, or hold, they know what they're committing to. Beachwalk is the building I know best, having worked there for years.

home.footerCta: Send the smallest useful signal. If there is a fit, Isaac replies with the building already in view.

beachwalk.memo: Beachwalk is the building I know best, having worked there for years. The value is not just knowing the view lines or the lobby rhythm. It is knowing which questions to ask before someone falls in love with a unit.

buy.title: Start with the building question.
buy.body: Tell us where you are looking, how you would buy, and what you want to avoid. We will use that to decide whether a short call is useful.

sell.title: Tell us what you own and what feels stuck.
sell.body: The sale question changes by building, timing, tenant status, and the story around the unit. A few details let us prepare before we reply.

own.title: Put a building expert in your corner.
own.body: Share the building, use mix, timing, and what is making you rethink the next decision. We review the context as your trusted advisor before suggesting a next step.
